title: ParentReference
description: Gateway API ParentReference identifying the Gateway (or other parent resource) this route attaches to.

group.description: Group of the referent. Defaults to gateway.networking.k8s.io when unspecified.

kind.description: Kind of the referent, e.g. Gateway.

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. Defaults to the route's namespace when unspecified.

sectionName.description: Name of a section (listener) within the parent resource.

port.description: Network port this route targets on the parent.
